entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Wha—?! [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. That Pokémon.
Isn’t
that
the
Pokémon
from
the
picture?![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_04

entries.text: That’s a real-life Gouging Fire! Just look at the\nshape of its head![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_a1_01

entries.text: There are rumors that say this fellow can make\nmagma erupt from the ground just by roaring![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_a1_02

entries.text: That’s a real-life Iron Boulder! That thing is\nBUILT! Wow.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_b1_01

entries.text: Rumors say that this fellow charges its horns\nwith energy, then uses them to plow through\r\neverything in its path![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_b1_02

entries.text: A real Raging Bolt! That neck is... Boy, that neck!\nIt’s almost too much to fit in one frame![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_a2_01

entries.text: Rumor has it that this fellow can cover the whole\nsky with dark clouds and bring lightning crashing\r\ndown, just by swinging that long neck around![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_a2_02

entries.text: A real Iron Crown! It’s so...so mecha![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_b2_01

entries.text: Rumor has it that this fellow can fire off beams\nfrom its horns that’ll cut through anything at all![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_b2_02

entries.text: Hahaha! If that were true, then this thing would\nbe a real fearsome threat to face!\c\nNow let me just snap a couple of photos here...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_05

entries.text: This could mean the other Pokémon I showed you\nis real, too. Report back to me if you find it, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_06

entries.text: Wow...you actually went and found them both!\c\nI can’t even be surprised—that’s just like you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_07

entries.text: Between you and me, I was having a hard time\nfocusing on my own work... I couldn’t keep my\r\nmind off of those photos. You saved me![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_08

entries.text: I know I didn’t promise any rewards or anything,\nbut I’ve got to thank you for putting the mystery\r\nto rest. Here you go! This prize is a real catch![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_09

entries.text: It’s wild how much mystery is left in the world,\nisn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_10

entries.text: When you’re a kid, you can just run wholehearted\nwherever you want, but it’s not so easy when you\r\nget older.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_11

entries.text: And now I think I’d better get back to work![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.text:
They keep adding more and more functions to
these camera apps, you know?\c
As a photographer, I guess I’ve gotta be able to
use filters and all that to stay cool, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_npc_01

entries.text:
Don’t just say hi to me all the time. Remember to
give Growlithe a bit of love too!\c
I think he remembers your scent. He seems to
really like you![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_npc_02

entries.text:
This Terarium really is something out of this
world. It’s hard to remember we’re under the sea.\c
And you can simply stroll from an ice-covered
mountain to a tropical island?!\c
It’s a photographer’s dream, being able to take
photos of all these different environments![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_npc_03

entries.text:
You remember those photos I took of you with
the Bloodmoon Beast? Even though they didn’t
turn out great, they’re still some of my favorites.\c
I treasure every last picture I took that night![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0030_camera_npc_04
